title: Java Developer
description: A roadmap for Java careers covering core Java, OOP, Spring Boot, databases, testing, build tools, APIs, and enterprise deployment.

tree.name: Core Java Foundations
tree.description: Learn Java syntax, OOP, collections, exceptions, generics, streams, concurrency basics, and JVM behavior.

resources.title: Java Full Course for Free (Bro Code)

children.name: OOP, Collections, and Generics
children.description: Model domains with classes, interfaces, records, enums, collections, generics, equals/hashCode, and immutability.

children.name: Streams and Concurrency Basics
children.description: Use streams, optionals, lambdas, executors, futures, synchronization, and thread-safety fundamentals.

tree.name: Spring Boot Backend Development
tree.description: Build REST APIs with Spring Boot, dependency injection, validation, persistence, configuration, and security.

children.name: REST APIs and Validation
children.description: Create controllers, services, DTOs, validation, error handling, pagination, OpenAPI docs, and API versioning.

children.name: Spring Data and Security
children.description: Use JPA repositories, transactions, migrations, auth, roles, password hashing, JWT, and secure defaults.

children.name: Practice: Spring Boot CRUD Module
children.description: Build a small CRUD module with validation, transactions, tests, migrations, and OpenAPI documentation.

tree.name: Testing and Enterprise Practices
tree.description: Work like a professional Java team with builds, tests, observability, messaging, and maintainable architecture.

children.name: Testing, Maven, and Gradle
children.description: Write unit/integration tests, use Testcontainers, manage dependencies, builds, profiles, and CI pipelines.

children.name: Messaging and Observability
children.description: Use queues/events, retries, idempotency, structured logging, metrics, tracing, and operational dashboards.

tree.name: Deployment and Portfolio
tree.description: Containerize, deploy, monitor, and document a Spring Boot application that resembles real enterprise work.

children.name: Production Deployment
children.description: Use Docker, environment config, database migrations, health checks, log aggregation, and rollback plans.

children.name: Project: Banking API
children.description: Build a Spring Boot API with auth, accounts, transactions, validation, PostgreSQL, tests, Docker, and audit logs.
